name: Software development
title: Software development | Corbel
desc: Custom platforms, internal tools and iOS and Android apps, built around how your business actually runs.
h1: Software built around how your business actually runs.
lede: Custom platforms and mobile apps for the work off-the-shelf tools can't handle: your approvals, your pricing rules, your operations. You own every line of code from the first commit.

deliver.title: Internal platforms
deliver.text: Operations, finance, logistics and approval workflows with role-based access and full audit trails.

deliver.title: Mobile apps
deliver.text: iOS and Android from one codebase, with offline sync, push notifications and in-app payments.

deliver.title: SaaS products
deliver.text: Multi-tenant products with billing, onboarding and admin tooling, built to grow with your customer base.

deliver.title: Legacy modernisation
deliver.text: Rebuild ageing systems piece by piece while the old one keeps running. No big-bang cut-over.

fit: Your team works around your tools instead of with them
Key processes live in spreadsheets, email threads or one person's head
You need software you own outright, with code in your own repository
An off-the-shelf product covers 70% of what you need and the rest is costing you

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: Workshops with the people who will use it, a map of your current process, and a prioritised backlog.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: Clickable screens for the riskiest workflows, tested with real users before we write production code.

steps.title: Build in sprints
steps.text: Two-week sprints with a demo each time. A staging site you can use from week one.

steps.title: Launch and hand-over
steps.text: Data migration, staff training, documentation and 30 days of free fixes.

faqs.q: Will we be locked in to Corbel?
faqs.a: No. The code lives in your repository, uses mainstream technology, and comes with documentation and tests. Several clients have taken our work in-house.

faqs.q: Can you build for iOS and Android at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. We use React Native or Flutter so one team ships both apps from a single codebase, with native modules where performance needs it.

faqs.q: Do you work with our in-house developers?
faqs.a: Often. We can lead the project and pair with your team, or slot in as extra capacity under your tech lead.

name: Web development
title: Web development | Corbel
desc: Fast, accessible websites, customer portals and e-commerce that your own team can update.
h1: Websites and portals that load fast and stay easy to change.
lede: Company sites, customer portals and online stores that load in about a second, meet accessibility standards, and can be edited by your own team without calling a developer.

deliver.title: Company websites
deliver.text: Content-managed marketing sites with clean structure, strong SEO foundations and analytics set up properly.

deliver.title: Customer portals
deliver.text: Self-service accounts, order tracking, statements and support, connected to your back-office systems.

deliver.title: E-commerce
deliver.text: Headless storefronts with local and international payments, inventory sync and fast product pages.

deliver.title: Performance and accessibility audits
deliver.text: A prioritised report on speed, SEO and WCAG issues, with fixes we make or hand to your team.

fit: Your current site is slow on mobile or hard to update
Customers call or email for information they could look up themselves
You sell online and need payments, stock and delivery to stay in sync
You are rebranding and want the site rebuilt properly, not reskinned

steps.title: Content and structure
steps.text: Sitemap, page templates and a content plan agreed with your marketing team.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Design system and key page designs, reviewed on real devices before build.

steps.title: Build and CMS setup
steps.text: Pages built against a performance budget, with your team editing content in the CMS as we go.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Redirects, analytics, search console and a launch checklist, then training for your editors.

faqs.q: Can our marketing team edit the site themselves?
faqs.a: Yes. Every site comes with a CMS set up around your content, and a training session. Most changes never need a developer.

faqs.q: Will we lose our search rankings when we move?
faqs.a: Not if the move is planned. We map every old URL to a new one, keep metadata, and monitor search console for the first months.

faqs.q: Do you design the site as well?
faqs.a: Yes. Our designers handle the visual design and content structure, or we can work from your agency's designs.

name: Integrations
title: Integrations | Corbel
desc: Connect payments, mobile money, CRM, ERP and logistics systems so data is entered once and trusted everywhere.
h1: Make the systems you already pay for work as one.
lede: Payments, mobile money, CRM, accounting and logistics tools connected properly. Data is entered once, moves automatically, and failures are caught before your customers notice.

deliver.title: Payments and mobile money
deliver.text: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, card and bank integrations with automatic reconciliation and refunds.

deliver.title: CRM and ERP sync
deliver.text: Two-way sync between Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP Business One, Odoo, QuickBooks and Xero.

deliver.title: APIs and middleware
deliver.text: Well-documented APIs and integration layers with queues, retries and idempotency built in.

deliver.title: Monitoring and alerting
deliver.text: Dashboards and alerts for every integration, so a failed sync is fixed in minutes rather than found at month end.

fit: Staff copy data between systems by hand every day
Finance and operations disagree on the numbers
You are adding a new tool and need it to work with the rest
An existing integration fails silently and nobody notices until month end

steps.title: Systems audit
steps.text: We document every system, the data that moves between them, and where it breaks today.

steps.title: Integration design
steps.text: Data mapping, error handling and a test plan, agreed with finance and operations.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.text: Built against sandbox accounts, then tested with real data in a controlled rollout.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.text: Dashboards and alerts go live with the integration, plus a runbook for your team.

faqs.q: What if the other system doesn't have an API?
faqs.a: We have integrated with file exports, email parsing and database replication when there was no API. We will tell you the trade-offs up front.

faqs.q: Who maintains the integration after launch?
faqs.a: Your choice. We hand over documentation and runbooks, or keep it running under a support retainer with alerting.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing vendors?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly coordinate with ERP partners and payment providers on your behalf.

name: Cloud solutions
title: Cloud solutions | Corbel
desc: Cloud migration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and cost reviews on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
h1: Infrastructure that is cheaper to run and easier to change.
lede: Move off ageing servers, cut your hosting bill, and ship new releases without holding your breath. Every environment is written down as code, so nothing depends on one person's memory.

deliver.title: Cloud migration
deliver.text: Planned moves from on-site servers or other providers, with rehearsed cut-overs and rollback plans.

deliver.title: Infrastructure as code
deliver.text: Every environment defined in Terraform, reviewed like application code, and reproducible in an afternoon.

deliver.title: CI/CD and DevOps
deliver.text: Automated tests and deployments so releasing is routine, not a weekend event.

deliver.title: Cost and security reviews
deliver.text: Right-sizing, reserved capacity and access audits. Most reviews pay for themselves within three months.

fit: Critical systems run on a server in your office
Your cloud bill keeps growing and nobody is sure why
Deployments are manual, risky or only one person can do them
You need to meet a security or data-residency requirement

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: An inventory of what you run, what it costs, and a migration or improvement plan with a fixed price.

steps.title: Foundations
steps.text: Accounts, networking, access control and Terraform set up the right way from the start.

steps.title: Migrate or rebuild
steps.text: Workloads moved in planned waves, each with a rehearsed cut-over and rollback.

steps.title: Optimise
steps.text: Monthly cost and security reviews, patching and backup restore tests.

faqs.q: Which cloud provider should we use?
faqs.a: It depends on your team, existing licences and where your customers are. We work across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and will recommend one with reasons.

faqs.q: Will there be downtime during migration?
faqs.a: We plan for minimal or zero downtime, with cut-overs rehearsed in advance and scheduled outside your busy hours.

faqs.q: Can you reduce our current cloud bill?
faqs.a: Usually. Clients typically save 20 to 40% through right-sizing, reserved capacity and removing forgotten resources.
